abstract: The pollution caused by conventional plastic food packaging can pose a significant environmental challenge. Our study uses a discrete choice experiment to examine consumer preferences for various types of sustainable milk packaging. To reveal the behavioral mechanisms involved in decisions regarding sustainable packaging, we incorporate two behavioral choice frameworks: random utility maximization and random regret minimization. The results indicate that consumer preferences vary with the different behavioral frameworks, demonstrating significant heterogeneity in consumer tastes. Furthermore, consumer preferences for sustainable packaging are influenced by their purchase frequency, trust, and conservation awareness. Our findings support food industry’s sustainable transition and packaging adoption.

title: The Impact of Echinococcosis Interventions on Cattle and Sheep Farmers' Quality of Life in Qinghai Province of China
abstract: Hydatid disease, a serious zoonotic condition affecting both humans and animals, often leads to substantial repercussions for cattle and sheep farmers, necessitating effective preventive and control measures. This research employs data from a survey of 504 cattle and sheep farmers in Qinghai Province, China, spanning four years (2015, 2017, 2019, and 2021). Utilizing an individual fixed-effects model, the study scrutinizes the influence of hydatid disease control policies on farmers’ quality of life and unravels the underlying mechanisms. Our findings reveal that echinococcosis interventions substantially enhance farmers’ quality of life. However, the efficacy of these policies can differ based on factors such as the altitude of a farmer’s residence and their education levels. Our analysis of mechanism suggests that these interventions improve quality of life by ameliorating human and animal health and by enhancing environmental conditions. The study offers valuable insights for the management of zoonotic diseases and contributes to the enhancement of farmers’ quality of life.
abstract_zh: 包虫病是一种严重的人畜共患病，同时影响人类和动物，常常给牛羊养殖户带来重大影响，因此需要有效的预防和控制措施。本研究利用青海省504名牛羊养殖户的调查数据，时间跨度为四年（2015、2017、2019和2021年）。研究采用个体固定效应模型，考察包虫病防控政策对农户生活质量的影响，并揭示其内在机制。研究发现，棘球蚴病干预措施显著提高了农户的生活质量。然而，这些政策的效果会因农户居住地海拔、受教育程度等因素而有所不同。机制分析表明，这些干预措施通过改善人类与动物健康以及优化环境条件来提升生活质量。本研究为人畜共患病的管理提供了有价值的启示，并有助于提升农户的生活质量。

abstract: This analysis provides two case studies comparing direct payment versus charitable donations on respondents' behalf as survey participation incentives. The first examines agricultural producers' willingness to participate in several hypothetical surveys. Donation to charity significantly increases producers' willingness to participate relative to direct payment. The second case study examines forest landowners' willingness to participate in an actual, one‐time survey. Neither payment nor donation incentives improve participation among mail respondents and donations are less effective versus payment among online respondents. If they do not decrease participation, then donations may be preferred, requiring less effort to process a smaller number of transactions.
abstract_zh: 本分析提供了两个案例研究，比较了直接支付与代表受访者向慈善机构捐款，作为调查参与激励的效果。第一个案例考察了农业生产者在若干假设性调查中的参与意愿。向慈善机构捐款能显著提高生产者相对于直接支付的参与意愿。第二个案例考察了林地所有者参与一项实际的一次性调查的意愿。无论是支付还是捐款激励，都未能提高邮寄问卷受访者的参与率；而对于在线受访者，捐款相较于支付效果更差。如果不会降低参与率，那么捐款可能更受青睐，因为它所需处理的交易笔数较少，所需工作量也更小。

Energy Constraint in China at the Expense of Profitability? Perspective of Green Technology Innovation
abstract: Although energy constraints, green technology innovation increment, and corporate profitability are issues of central importance to enterprise management and the environment, many aspects of these elements have been neglected in the present work. Using data from listed manufacturing firms in China, this study presents two major findings. First, the authors identify a u-shaped relationship between city-specific energy constraints and business profitability. Second, they find green technology innovation can significantly drive profitability in different types of industries. In addition, the profitability of certain enterprises, such as those that are smaller and younger can be more drastically affected by energy constraints. To develop a green innovation-driven strategy to allow manufacturing enterprises to achieve greater profitability and promote ecological improvements, they recommend energy policies be more individualized to guide “energy-constraint sensitive” enterprises to success.
abstract_zh: 尽管能源约束、绿色技术创新增量与企业盈利能力都是企业管理和环境领域的核心问题，但现有研究对这些要素的许多方面仍有所忽视。本研究利用中国上市制造业企业的数据，得出两项主要发现。第一，作者识别出城市层面的能源约束与企业盈利能力之间存在U形关系。第二，他们发现绿色技术创新能够显著推动不同类型行业的盈利能力。此外，某些企业（如规模较小、成立时间较短的企业）的盈利能力可能受能源约束的影响更为剧烈。为了制定绿色创新驱动战略，使制造业企业实现更高盈利并促进生态改善，作者建议能源政策应更具针对性，以引导“对能源约束敏感”的企业取得成功。

title: Enhancing Rural Income through Public Agricultural R&D: Spatial Spillover and Infrastructure Thresholds
abstract: How much farmers benefit from public agricultural research and development (R&D) has been a topic of continued interest. Compared to studies based on classical statistics, we show theoretically and employ the Spatial Durbin Model and the Panel Threshold Regression Model to investigate the different impacts and spatial spillover effects of public agricultural R&D on farm and nonfarm income. Using China's provincial panel data from 2000 to 2015, we find that public agricultural R&D has a positive impact on rural household income. This impact is mainly reflected by nonfarm income and exhibits heterogeneous interprovincial‐spatial spillover. We also find that interregional differences in infrastructure, represented by road transportation and Internet access in rural areas, are the main reasons for the spatial heterogeneity. Higher road density and Internet penetration enhance the positive impact of public agricultural R&D on rural income, and the enhancement exhibits characteristics of thresholds, after which the size of enhancement becomes increasingly larger.
abstract_zh: 农民从公共农业研发（R&D）中获益多少，一直是人们持续关注的话题。与基于经典统计方法的研究相比，我们从理论上论证了这一问题，并采用空间杜宾模型和面板门槛回归模型，考察了公共农业研发对农业收入和非农收入的不同影响以及空间溢出效应。利用2000至2015年中国省级面板数据，我们发现，公共农业研发对农村家庭收入具有正向影响。这一影响主要体现在非农收入上，并表现出异质性的省际空间溢出效应。我们还发现，以农村道路交通和互联网接入衡量的基础设施区域差异，是造成空间异质性的主要原因。更高的道路密度和互联网普及率增强了公共农业研发对农村收入的正向影响，并且这种增强效应呈现门槛特征，超过门槛后，增强幅度将越来越大。

Kentucky Soybean Farmers' Supportiveness of Two Integrated Pest and Pollinator Management Tactics
abstract: Beneficial insect conservation in agriculture is often studied in the context of integrated pest management (IPM). For instance, vegetative field edges provide habitat and changing the timing of insecticidal sprays decreases risk for pollinators and natural enemies of insect pests. However, the attitudes and confidence of U.S. growers towards IPM implementation in traditional row crops remain understudied. We developed an online survey using a convenience sample and surveyed Kentucky soybean growers to understand their current pest and general management practices, beliefs about sources of insect pests/weeds, and attitudes towards pollinators. We also asked about their willingness to implement two management tactics—maintaining tree-lined field edges and changing the timing of their combination insecticide/fungicide sprays to avoid flowering. Our data indicate that many Kentucky soybean growers already use crop rotation, no-till soil management, and limit insecticide application based on high pest abundance. When asked about their management of field edges, the most common responses included removal of trees/shrubs, mowing, or herbicide application. Growers also believed that nationally, farmers can influence pollinator populations and that a portion of the soybean yield is due to pollinator activity within crop fields. However, they were less willing to maintain tree lines as a habitat for natural enemies and pollinators out of concern for the increased spread of weeds and insect pests. Given these findings, we need to evaluate the perceived and actual trade-offs of weed and insect pest management in future on-farm conservation efforts for beneficial insects such as pollinators using integrated pest and pollinator management.
abstract_zh: 农业中有益昆虫的保护通常是在综合虫害治理（IPM）的框架下进行研究的。例如，植被型田间边缘可以提供栖息地，而调整杀虫剂喷施的时间可以降低传粉昆虫和害虫天敌的风险。然而，美国种植者对在传统大田作物中实施综合虫害治理的态度和信心，目前仍研究不足。我们采用便利抽样设计了一份在线问卷，对肯塔基州的大豆种植者进行调查，以了解他们目前的病虫害及一般管理实践、对害虫/杂草来源的看法，以及对传粉昆虫的态度。我们还询问了他们是否愿意实施两种管理措施——保留树木排列的田间边缘，以及调整其杀虫剂/杀菌剂复合喷施的时间以避开开花期。我们的数据表明，许多肯塔基州大豆种植者已经在采用轮作、免耕土壤管理，并在虫害数量较多时才限制杀虫剂的使用。在被问及田间边缘的管理方式时，最常见的回答包括清除树木/灌木、割草或施用除草剂。种植者还认为，从全国范围来看，农民能够影响传粉昆虫的数量，并且大豆产量的一部分来自田间作物内的传粉昆虫活动。然而，出于对杂草和害虫扩散加剧的担忧，他们不太愿意保留树林带作为天敌和传粉昆虫的栖息地。鉴于这些发现，我们需要在未来的田间保护工作中，利用综合虫害与传粉昆虫管理的方法，评估杂草和害虫管理的感知权衡与实际权衡，以保护传粉昆虫等有益昆虫。

Farmer Preference for Swine Price Index Insurance
abstract:
Purpose
The purpose of this paper is to examine farmer preference for swine price index insurance in China focusing on whether Chinese farmers are willing to consider purchasing swine price index insurance, the premium they would like to pay, as well as the extend of heterogeneity in their preferences.
Design/methodology/approach
A sample of 443 swine farmers in Jiangsu and Henan provinces is collected and analyzed. An Ordered Probit model is used to analyze farmers’ willingness to buy swine price index insurance and a Tobit model is used to analyze farmers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for insurance premium.
Findings
Results show that some farmers are not willing to purchase swine price index insurance. However, WTP of majority of farmers is higher than what is prescribed in the current insurance policy. Factors affecting farmers’ willingness to buy varied between two provinces. Experience in purchasing traditional swine insurance and risk perception affect farmers’ willingness to buy in Jiangsu province, while joining agricultural cooperatives, experience in purchasing traditional swine insurance and understanding of swine price index insurance affect farmers’ willingness to buy in Henan province. Farmers with non-agricultural income, longer years of swine breeding, higher degree of specialization, experience in purchasing traditional insurance, higher understanding of swine price index insurance and trust in local governments, stronger risk perception and risk preference, and not being a member of agricultural cooperatives have higher WTP.
Originality/value
Few studies have been conducted on swine price index insurance in China. Even less information, to the authors’ knowledge, is available on farmer preferences. The research provides a timely contribution to understand the Chinese swine price index insurance market from the perspectives of farmers.
abstract_zh:
目的
本文旨在考察中国农户对生猪价格指数保险的偏好，重点关注中国农户是否愿意考虑购买生猪价格指数保险、他们愿意支付的保费水平，以及其偏好的异质性程度。
设计/方法/途径
本文收集并分析了江苏和河南两省443户生猪养殖户的样本。采用有序Probit模型分析农户购买生猪价格指数保险的意愿，并采用Tobit模型分析农户对保险保费的支付意愿（WTP）。
研究发现
结果表明，部分农户不愿意购买生猪价格指数保险。然而，大多数农户的支付意愿高于当前保险政策规定的保费水平。影响农户购买意愿的因素在两省之间存在差异。在江苏省，传统生猪保险的购买经验和风险认知影响农户的购买意愿；而在河南省，加入农业合作社、传统生猪保险的购买经验以及对生猪价格指数保险的理解程度影响农户的购买意愿。非农收入、养殖年限较长、专业化程度较高、有传统保险的购买经验、对生猪价格指数保险的理解程度较高、对地方政府的信任度较高、风险认知和风险偏好较强，以及未加入农业合作社的农户，其支付意愿更高。
原创性/价值
针对中国生猪价格指数保险的研究较少，而据作者所知，关于农户偏好的信息则更加有限。本研究从农户视角理解中国生猪价格指数保险市场，为此提供了及时的贡献。

The Buzz about Bee Campuses: Student Thoughts Regarding Pollinator Conservation
abstract: The decline of insect pollinators in North America is alarming because it may have broad effects on multiple industries and ecosystem health (Gallai et al. 2009, Potts et al. 2010, Cameron et al. 2011). Although honey bees remain the focus of most media coverage regarding pollinators (Smith et al. 2016), the decline in populations of other insects also essential to pollination, such as bumble bees and solitary bees, is concerning (Steffan-Dewenter et al. 2005, Winfree et al. 2011). Previous studies have evaluated the public’s knowledge and support of honey bees and other pollinators, and the results suggest that the public interest in pollinators exceeds their understanding of conservation requirements (Wilson et al. 2017, Penn et al. 2019). Several U.S. pollinator conservation programs, ranging from government legislation to non-profit organizations, have developed platforms and missions to protect pollinators. A prominent example is the Obama Administration’s National Strategy to Promote the Health of Honey Bees and Other Pollinators, which proposed three separate five- to ten-year goals for pollinator protection in the United States (Pollinator Health Task Force 2015). The Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) and the new Pollinator Habitat Initiative (CP-42) enables landowners to create native plant landscapes for honey bees and other pollinators through governmental incentives (USDA FSA 2020). Other programs, such as the 2018–2030 Pollinator Initiative, Monarch Watch’s “Monarch Waystation” Program, National Pollinator Garden Network’s Million Pollinator Garden Challenge, the Xerces Society’s “Bring Back the Pollinators” Campaign, and Pollinator Partnership’s North American Pollinator Protection Campaign, all have goals to reach international audiences and encourage adoption of a wide array of pollinator-friendly practices.
abstract_zh: 北美昆虫传粉者数量的下降令人担忧，因为它可能对多个产业和生态系统健康产生广泛影响（Gallai et al. 2009, Potts et al. 2010, Cameron et al. 2011）。尽管媒体对传粉者的报道大多以蜜蜂为焦点（Smith et al. 2016），但熊蜂和独居蜂等同样对授粉至关重要的昆虫种群数量下降，同样令人担忧（Steffan-Dewenter et al. 2005, Winfree et al. 2011）。以往研究评估了公众对蜜蜂及其他传粉者的认知与支持程度，结果表明，公众对传粉者的关注程度超过了其对保护要求的理解（Wilson et al. 2017, Penn et al. 2019）。美国有多项传粉者保护计划，涵盖从政府立法到非营利组织的各个层面，并制定了保护传粉者的平台与使命。一个突出的例子是奥巴马政府的《促进蜜蜂及其他传粉者健康国家战略》，该战略为美国传粉者保护提出了三个各为五至十年的独立目标（Pollinator Health Task Force 2015）。保护储备计划（CRP）和新的传粉者栖息地计划（CP-42）通过政府激励措施，使土地所有者能够为蜜蜂及其他传粉者营造本土植物景观（USDA FSA 2020）。其他项目，例如2018–2030传粉者倡议、Monarch Watch的“帝王蝶驿站”计划、National Pollinator Garden Network的“百万传粉者花园挑战”、Xerces Society的“让传粉者回来”运动，以及Pollinator Partnership的北美传粉者保护运动，均致力于覆盖国际受众，并鼓励采用多种传粉者友好型做法。

title: Are Free Trade Agreements Good for the Environment? A Panel Data Analysis
abstract:
This study empirically examines the relationship between free trade agreements (
FTA
s) and greenhouse gas (
GHG
) emissions. For this purpose, we use three different
FTA
s: the Southern Common Market, the North American Free Trade Agreement, and the Australia–United States Free Trade Agreement. These
FTA
s are between developing, both developing and developed, and only developed countries, respectively. Panel unit root, panel cointegration, and fully modified ordinary least squares estimations are employed to examine the long‐run relationship between
GHG
emissions and trade liberalization. The results indicate that the environmental effects of
FTA
s depend on the different agreement types. When
FTA
s are between only developed or developing countries, overall there is no environmental damage, and these types of
FTA
s can be beneficial for the environmental quality in the long run. However, when developing and developed countries are in a trade agreement, overall environmental quality decreases due to increased
GHG
emissions.
abstract_zh: 本研究实证考察了自由贸易协定（FTAs）与温室气体（GHG）排放之间的关系。为此，我们使用了三个不同的自由贸易协定：南方共同市场、北美自由贸易协定以及澳大利亚—美国自由贸易协定。这些自由贸易协定分别发生在发展中国家之间、发展中国家与发达国家之间，以及仅发达国家之间。我们采用面板单位根检验、面板协整检验以及完全修正的普通最小二乘法（FMOLS）估计，考察温室气体排放与贸易自由化之间的长期关系。结果表明，自由贸易协定的环境效应取决于协定类型。当自由贸易协定仅发生在发达国家或发展中国家之间时，总体上不会造成环境损害，这类协定从长期看可能有利于环境质量。然而，当发展中国家与发达国家处于同一贸易协定中时，由于温室气体排放增加，环境质量总体下降。

abstract_zh: 欧洲蜜蜂（Apis mellifera）数量的下降，一直是公众支持传粉者保护及相关保护工作的重要组成部分，尽管蜜蜂并非北美本土物种，并且可能与本土昆虫传粉者争夺资源。然而，人们对于是什么因素使得公众对本土昆虫传粉者（包括占本土蜜蜂大多数的独居蜂）的支持有所不同，知之甚少。这些传粉者具有区别于蜜蜂的使用价值和非使用价值，尽管其中一些本土物种已经经历了更为剧烈的种群崩溃。我们利用从路易斯安那州普通公众和养蜂人收集的数据，采用条件价值评估法（contingent valuation method）考察保护独居蜂的价值。结果表明，人们对独居蜂保护表现出中等程度的正向支付意愿，并且养蜂人的支付意愿可能高于普通公众。普通公众与养蜂人在对蜜蜂及其他传粉者的认知和态度方面存在显著的异质性。

title: Willingness-to-Pay for Shrimp with Homegrown by Heroes, Community Supported Fishery, Best Aquaculture Practices, or Local Attributes
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: With the seafood food market endowed with various attributes, consumers may prefer certain certifications over others. By surveying a diverse sample of respondents, this study examines consumer preference for farm-raised shrimp in Kentucky and South Carolina. Respondents’ assessment of certain seafood labels is evaluated using a stated preference survey. Willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates and various product profiles are generated. Consistent with previous studies, a strong preference for fresh and “local” was found. Furthermore, Homegrown by Heroes was highly valued among participants, as well as Best Aquaculture Practices. Based on WTP estimates for these attributes, marketing and policy recommendations are discussed.
abstract_zh: 由于海产品市场具有多种属性，消费者可能会偏好某些认证而非其他认证。本研究通过对多样化的受访样本进行调查，考察了消费者对肯塔基州和南卡罗来纳州养殖虾的偏好。我们利用陈述偏好调查，评估了受访者对特定海产品标签的评价。研究得出了支付意愿（WTP）估计值，并构建了多种产品组合。与以往研究一致，我们发现消费者对新鲜和“本地”产品有强烈偏好。此外，参与者对“Homegrown by Heroes”认证以及“最佳水产养殖规范”（Best Aquaculture Practices）认证给予了高度评价。基于这些属性的支付意愿估计值，本文讨论了营销和政策建议。

Public Knowledge of Monarchs and Support for Butterfly Conservation
abstract: Pollinator populations in North America are in decline, including the iconic monarch butterfly. In order to determine if public knowledge of monarchs informs opinions on butterfly conservation, we surveyed the public to assess their knowledge of monarchs. We also asked participants about their attitudes towards general butterfly conservation and if they believe that butterfly gardens contribute to conservation. Respondents generally had some knowledge of monarchs but were unaware of monarch population declines and the necessity of milkweed to their life cycle. Respondent knowledge was correlated with more positive attitudes about butterfly conservation. Furthermore, membership in an environmental organization increased the likelihood that the participant had prior knowledge of monarchs and cared about monarch conservation. Respondent socioeconomic factors of age and sex were also significantly correlated with conservation attitudes—older and female participants had more positive attitudes towards general butterfly conservation. Interestingly, females were also less likely than males to admit having prior knowledge of monarchs, indicating that gender may also play an important role in conservation outreach efforts. Our study indicates that educational efforts need to be directed more toward individuals not already associated with an environmental organization as these individuals are predisposed to regard conservation positively.
abstract_zh: 北美的传粉者种群正在减少，其中包括标志性的帝王蝶。为了判断公众对帝王蝶的了解是否影响其对蝴蝶保护的看法，我们对公众进行了调查，以评估他们对帝王蝶的认知程度。我们还询问了受访者对一般蝴蝶保护的态度，以及他们是否认为蝴蝶花园有助于保护。受访者总体上对帝王蝶有一定了解，但并不知道帝王蝶种群正在下降，也不了解马利筋对其生命周期的必要性。受访者的知识水平与其对蝴蝶保护更积极的态度相关。此外，加入环保组织使参与者更有可能事先了解帝王蝶，并更加关心帝王蝶的保护。受访者的年龄和性别等社会经济因素也与保护态度显著相关——年龄较大的女性参与者对一般蝴蝶保护表现出更积极的态度。有趣的是，女性比男性更少承认自己事先了解帝王蝶，这表明性别在保护宣传工作中可能也发挥着重要作用。我们的研究表明，教育工作需要更多地面向尚未加入环保组织的人群，因为这些人群本身就倾向于积极看待保护工作。

title: Agricultural Technical Education and Agrochemical Use by Rice Farmers in China
abstract: Using participatory approaches and experimental economic methods, this paper analyzes the impacts of different types of agricultural technical education on farmers’ agrochemical use in China. Agricultural technical education is differentiated as training through a short course and additional personal guidance both offered through agricultural extension agencies. Results show that training alone may generate the desired result of reducing fertilizer usage. However, additional personal guidance does not support the intended goal of reducing the application of either fertilizer or pesticide. This study also detects technology diffusion effect in that farmers who are not offered education but are in the same village where the education programs are offered are more likely to change their behavior. Implications of this study call for better supervision and implementation of agricultural extension efforts in China. [EconLit citations: Q12, Q16, Q52]
abstract_zh: 本文采用参与式方法和实验经济学方法，分析了不同类型的农业技术教育对中国农户农用化学品使用的影响。农业技术教育被区分为通过短期培训课程的教育，以及由农业推广机构提供的额外个人指导。结果表明，仅仅接受培训就可能产生减少化肥使用的预期效果。然而，额外的个人指导并未实现减少化肥或农药施用的预期目标。本研究还发现了技术扩散效应：在提供教育项目的同一村庄中，未接受教育的农户更有可能改变其行为。本研究的启示是，中国需要加强对农业推广工作的监督与实施。[EconLit citations: Q12, Q16, Q52]

Using Market-Based Tools to Protect and Improve Water Quality in Kentucky
venue: Shaped by Water: Kentucky's Watersheds, Landscapes, and People
abstract: Market-based tools are first suggested in the 1960s considering how society could achieve long-term reductions in pollution without causing an undue burden on the economy. Instead of the government imposes controls (i.e., limiting the right to pollute), market incentives governed by economic principles could be used to guide individual players’ behavior. One of the strategies is to let polluters reallocate the pollution they generate among themselves, or in other words, they decide who actually does the pollution abatement. Those with high costs pollute more (abate less) and those with low costs pollute less (abate more). This type of reallocating through trading could save large amounts of money.
abstract_zh: 以市场为基础的工具最早出现于20世纪60年代，当时人们思考社会如何在不对经济造成过度负担的前提下，实现污染的长期削减。政府不再直接施加管制（即限制排污权），而是可以利用市场激励，依据经济原理引导个体行为者的行为。其中一种策略是允许污染者在彼此之间重新分配其产生的污染，换言之，由他们自行决定谁来承担污染削减的责任。治理成本高的主体会多排污（少削减），而治理成本低的主体则会少排污（多削减）。这种通过交易进行的再分配可以节省大量资金。

title: Are Consumers Willing to Pay More for Sustainable Products? A Study of Eco-labeled Tuna Steak
abstract: A high demand for seafood leads to overfishing, harms the long-term health of seafood stocks, and threatens environmental sustainability in oceans. Sustainability certification is one of the major sustainability movements and is known as eco-labeling. For instance, in the tuna industry, leading tuna brands have committed to protecting sea turtles by allowing the tracing of the source of their tuna “from catch to can.” This paper relies on an Internet survey on consumers from Kentucky conducted in July 2010. The survey investigates household-level tuna steak (sashimi grade) consumption and examines consumer preferences for eco-labeling (“Certified Turtle Safe” (CTS) in this study) while mimicking individuals’ seafood procurement processes. A random parameter logit model is utilized, and willingness-to-pay measures are calculated based on model estimation results. It was found that respondents on average preferred turtle-safe-labeled tuna steak and were likely to pay more for it; however, they were less likely to purchase wild-caught species, and insignificant results were found for pre-frozen. Moreover, significant heterogeneities were found across individuals regarding tuna steak purchases. The findings indicate evidence of public support for environmental friendliness, particularly with regard to eco-labeling.
abstract_zh: 海产品的高需求导致过度捕捞，损害海产品资源的长期健康，并威胁海洋的环境可持续性。可持续认证是主要的可持续发展运动之一，被称为生态标签。例如，在金枪鱼行业，主要金枪鱼品牌承诺通过允许追溯其金枪鱼“从捕获到罐装”的全过程来保护海龟。本文依据2010年7月对肯塔基州消费者开展的网络调查展开研究。该调查考察了家庭层面的金枪鱼排（生鱼片级）消费情况，并在模拟个人海产品采购过程的同时，考察消费者对生态标签（本研究中为“Certified Turtle Safe”（CTS））的偏好。本文采用随机参数Logit模型，并基于模型估计结果计算支付意愿。研究发现，受访者平均而言更偏好带有海龟安全标签的金枪鱼排，并且更有可能为其支付更高价格；然而，他们购买野生捕捞品种的可能性较低，而冷冻前处理的影响则不显著。此外，个体在金枪鱼排购买方面存在显著的异质性。研究结果表明，公众支持环境友好行为，特别是在生态标签方面。

title: Farmers' Willingness to Participate in Best Management Practices in Kentucky
venue: Journal of Environmental Planning and Management
abstract: This paper investigates farmers' willingness to participate in Best Management Practices (BMPs) through a proposed Water quality trading (WQT) program in Kentucky. This analysis includes two parts: the first part is to investigate the factors influencing farmers' current usage of BMPs; the second part is to estimate farmers' willingness to implement BMPs given different levels of compensation given in a survey. The results show that farmers who participate in the conservation programs are more likely to use BMPs, but these farmers may not accept the offer to implement additional BMPs. Farmers' experiences about BMPs are more likely to persuade them to adopt additional BMPs than the level of compensation. The results find that using riparian buffers, fencing off animals and building up waste storage facilities are responsive to the levels of compensation offered.
abstract_zh: 本文通过在肯塔基州拟议的水质交易（WQT）项目，考察农户参与最佳管理措施（BMPs）的意愿。本分析包括两个部分：第一部分考察影响农户当前使用最佳管理措施的因素；第二部分估计在调查中给定不同补偿水平时，农户实施最佳管理措施的意愿。结果表明，参与保护计划的农户更有可能使用最佳管理措施，但这些农户未必愿意接受实施额外最佳管理措施的提议。与补偿水平相比，农户以往使用最佳管理措施的经验更有可能促使其采用额外的最佳管理措施。研究发现，使用河岸缓冲带、围栏隔离牲畜以及建造粪污储存设施，对所提供的补偿水平有较强的反应。

abstract: Electricity needs have increased dramatically in the United States over the last 40 years, and in Kentucky, most of these needs have been met through burning coal, contributing to the release of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere in amounts never-before-seen in human history. Initiatives for using more sustainable energy are being adopted by institutions and specific departments across the nation. Fitness centers are no exception. One initiative that can be beneficial in terms of clean energy as well as outreach involves encouraging patrons of fitness centers to use exercise machines that create electricity, harnessing the energy produced during their workouts. However, high start-up costs associated with these programs make their success highly dependent on a reasonable payback period. The study described in this article analyzed user behavior at the University of Kentucky (Lexington) Johnson Recreation Center from June 2011 through May 2013. The goal was to identify factors contributing to differences in electricity outputs in an effort to understand workout behavior and to make a more reasonable payback period for such programs. During the study, a promotional campaign, Burn to Earn, encouraged the usage of 16 Precor elliptical machines retrofitted with ReRev technology, which enables kinetic energy to be converted into electricity. Results indicate that the Burn to Earn program was successful in increasing usage of the Precor elliptical machines, mostly by users choosing to use these machines instead of other exercise equipment that had not been retrofitted. An increase in usage would translate into more energy converted and saved and thus a more reasonable payback period for the initial investment in the machines.
abstract_zh: 过去40年间，美国的电力需求大幅增长，而在肯塔基州，这些需求大多通过燃烧煤炭来满足，从而导致二氧化碳排放量达到人类历史上前所未有的水平。各机构和各地政府部门正在全国范围内推行更具可持续性的能源使用举措。健身中心也不例外。一项既有利于清洁能源又有利于宣传推广的举措，是鼓励健身中心的会员使用能够发电的健身器械，利用锻炼过程中产生的能量。然而，此类项目的高初始成本使其成功与否高度依赖于合理的投资回收期。本文所述研究分析了2011年6月至2013年5月期间，肯塔基大学（列克星敦）Johnson娱乐中心的用户行为。研究目标是找出导致电力产出差异的因素，以理解锻炼行为，并为此类项目确定更为合理的投资回收期。研究期间，一项名为“Burn to Earn”的促销活动鼓励人们使用配备了ReRev技术的16台Precor椭圆机，该技术可将动能转化为电能。结果表明，“Burn to Earn”项目成功提高了Precor椭圆机的使用率，其增长主要来自用户选择使用这些机器而非其他未改装的健身器材。使用率的提高意味着转化和节约的能量更多，从而使机器的初始投资能够在更合理的投资回收期内收回。

The Influence of Labor Price Change on Agricultural Machinery Usage in Chinese Agriculture
abstract: The substitution between rural labor and machinery has been a key determinant of farm production, structure, and efficiency in most developed countries and is expected to play a key role in shaping the future of Chinese agriculture. Using disaggregated farm‐level data from Hebei and Shandong provinces of China, we calculated the Allen and Morishima elasticities of substitution between labor and machinery. These elasticities were based on seemingly unrelated regressions and three‐stage least squares estimates of the translog cost function and input cost share functions. In contrast to previous studies, we dissaggregate machinery inputs into three categories: large, medium, and small. In addition, the issue of endogeneity in output quantity and input prices is also addressed. The results show strong evidence of substitution between labor and the three categories of machinery inputs. The findings also support substitution among the three categories of machinery themselves.
abstract_zh: 在大多数发达国家，农村劳动力与机械之间的替代关系一直是决定农业生产、经营结构和效率的关键因素，并有望在塑造中国农业未来的过程中发挥关键作用。利用河北省和山东省的分类农户层面数据，我们基于似不相关回归（SUR）和三阶段最小二乘法（3SLS）对超越对数成本函数及投入成本份额函数的估计，计算了劳动与机械之间的Allen替代弹性和Morishima替代弹性。与以往研究不同，我们将机械投入细分为大型、中型和小型三类。此外，本文还处理了产出数量和投入价格的内生性问题。结果表明，劳动与三类机械投入之间存在显著的替代关系。研究结果还支持三类机械之间本身存在替代关系。

Valuing the Benefit of Reducing Adverse Effects from Polluting Heating Fuels
abstract:
Indoor air pollution (IAP) from combustion‐generated pollutants, which are generated by solid fuel combustion for heating, has received considerable attention in recent years based on its health hazards for the human body. This article focuses on the health risk of heating fuel choice and estimates the health benefit (monetary benefits from medical expense savings) related to the improvement of the heating system.
Using the Kentucky Homeplace Program survey data and a health production function framework, this article explored the health implications of heating fuel choice by estimating the relationship between individuals’ use of polluting heating fuel and the number of medical services received annually.
The results show that using polluting heating increases doctor visits and medical expenses. Individuals may pay as much as about $135.99 for shifting from using polluting heating to nonpolluting heating.
The result provides some evidence to support the linkage between health risks and polluting heating use. Some demographic and lifestyle characteristics did have significant effects on medical care expenses. Government could consider subsidies to encourage lower income groups to shift to nonpolluting heating fuels or use improved technology in order to reduce the public insurance cost.
abstract_zh:
由固体燃料燃烧取暖产生的燃烧性污染物所导致的室内空气污染（IAP），因其对人体健康的危害，近年来受到了广泛关注。本文关注取暖燃料选择的健康风险，并估算了与供暖系统改善相关的健康收益（即医疗费用节省所带来的货币收益）。
本文利用肯塔基州“Homeplace项目”的调查数据，并采用健康生产函数框架，通过估计个体使用污染性取暖燃料与其每年接受医疗服务次数之间的关系，探讨了取暖燃料选择的健康影响。
结果表明，使用污染性取暖燃料会增加就诊次数和医疗费用。个体从使用污染性取暖转向非污染性取暖，其愿意支付的金额可能高达约135.99美元。
该结果为健康风险与污染性取暖使用之间的联系提供了一定证据。一些人口统计学和生活方式特征对医疗费用确实有显著影响。政府可以考虑提供补贴，鼓励低收入群体转向非污染性取暖燃料，或采用改进的技术，以降低公共保险成本。

Willingness to Pay for Broadband Access by Kentucky Farmers
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Since the Internet's inception its impact has been felt across the United States, but the distribution and adoption of the Internet has not necessarily been uniform geographically. As more consumers and businesses rely on the Internet to access information, the data transmission requirements have also increased. Consequently, access to broadband has become increasingly more important since dial-up cannot realistically handle the increased requirements. The use of broadband in agriculture can provide better access to price, weather, and management information while also opening new markets. However, many rural communities lag behind urban areas in broadband access and adoption rates. This study evaluates, through the use of a producer survey, the level of broadband Internet use, motivations for its use, degree of access to broadband, and willingness-to-pay (WTP) to fund broadband infrastructure investments. Results from the producer survey suggested farmers utilize the Internet primarily for accessing weather reports, e-mail, market reports, and agricultural news. Notably, the survey's WTP questions allowed for the use of an interval regression to calculate producer WTP for varying demographics. The results suggested that producers who were younger, farmed larger farms, and those who currently use the Internet but do not have broadband access were WTP more in property taxes to support broadband infrastructure investments than those of a differing demographic. Because WTP levels varied drastically depending on the underlying demographics, it becomes difficult to pinpoint a WTP level for a one-time payment in property taxes that would be acceptable from a policy standpoint.
abstract_zh: 自互联网诞生以来，其影响已遍及美国各地，但互联网的分布与普及在地理上并不一定均衡。随着越来越多的消费者和企业依赖互联网获取信息，数据传输需求也随之增加。因此，由于拨号上网已无法满足日益增长的需求，宽带接入变得越来越重要。宽带在农业中的应用，可以提供更好的价格、天气和管理信息的获取渠道，同时开辟新的市场。然而，许多农村社区在宽带接入和普及率方面落后于城市地区。本研究通过生产者调查，评估了宽带互联网的使用水平、使用动机、宽带接入程度，以及为宽带基础设施投资提供资金的支付意愿（WTP）。生产者调查结果表明，农民主要利用互联网获取天气预报、电子邮件、市场报告和农业新闻。值得注意的是，调查中的支付意愿问题允许使用区间回归来计算不同人口特征生产者的支付意愿。结果表明，相较于其他人口特征的群体，较年轻、经营规模较大的生产者，以及目前使用互联网但未接入宽带的生产者，更愿意通过财产税一次性支付以支持宽带基础设施投资。由于支付意愿水平因基础人口特征而存在巨大差异，因此很难从政策角度确定一个可接受的一次性财产税支付水平。

venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: In this study we found that Japanese consumers value the conventional health claim “low in saturated fat” more than the relatively newer claims, such as “high in oleic acid.” In addition, consumers do not prefer oil with genetically modified ingredients or oil that is not domestically produced, but they are willing to pay extra for “organic” or “functional food” features. We also found that the scope and source of information on these credence attributes may also affect consumers' choices and willingness to pay and that the effects may not be completely consistent with what one would expect.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们发现，日本消费者比起相对较新的声称，例如“富含油酸”，更看重传统的健康声称“低饱和脂肪”。此外，消费者并不偏好含有转基因成分的食用油，或非国产食用油，但他们愿意为“有机”或“功能性食品”特征额外付费。我们还发现，关于这些信任属性（credence attributes）的信息范围和来源，也可能影响消费者的选择和支付意愿，而且其效果未必完全符合人们的预期。

title: Labeling Context and Reference Point Effects in Models of Food Attribute Demand
Use of Spike Models in Measuring Consumers' Willingness to Pay for Non-GM Oil
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: In this paper, Chinese consumers' preferences and their willingness to pay (WTP) for non-genetically modified (GM) vegetable oil were elicited by a payment card approach. In addition to the conventional model, spike models, which were originally developed to evaluate public goods, were adopted in this paper. These spike models recognize the possibility of zero WTP and provide opportunities to analyze two correlated decision stages: whether to pay a premium for non-GM oil and how much the premium is. Results show that consumers behaved consistently in the two decision stages and there is a premium associated with non-GM oil.
abstract_zh: 本文采用支付卡方法，考察了中国消费者对非转基因（non-GM）植物油的偏好及支付意愿（WTP）。除传统模型外，本文还采用了最初用于评估公共物品的尖峰模型（spike models）。这些尖峰模型承认支付意愿可能为零，并允许分析两个相关的决策阶段：是否为非转基因油支付溢价，以及溢价的金额。结果表明，消费者在两个决策阶段的行为是一致的，并且非转基因油存在相应的溢价。

title: Labeling Genetically Modified Food: Heterogeneous Consumer Preferences and the Value of Information

Agricultural Biotechnology: A Comparison of Consumers' Preferences for Selected Policy Options
abstract:
This paper reports on a study of consumers' preferences for regulatory policies that relate to food biotechnology. Data on consumers' choices of selected policy options were collected through a telephone survey of Alberta residents conducted in early 2000. Conditional and mixed logit models were developed and tested. These assess the influence of different socio‐economic factors on respondents' choices of particular policy options and are used to estimate respondents' willingness to pay for two policy options that were the major focus of the study, specifically:
a food labeling system that gives more information about agricultural biotechnology for
food more food inspection.
In the course of the telephone interviews, consumers were asked to choose between one of these policy options and the option of more restrictive regulation for agricultural biotechnology. The results of the analysis suggest that the sampled consumers tend to most prefer and be most willing to pay for the information provided by a food labeling policy; there is a preference for a labeling policy that will give more information over a policy of more restrictive regulation. Similarly, a policy that will increase food inspection tends to be preferred to more restrictive regulation. There are gender differences in preferences, with females being willing to pay more than males for both the food policy options of labeling and inspection relative to agricultural biotechnology.
L'article expose une étude sur les préférences des consommateurs à l'égard des politiques visant à réglementer la biotechnologie dans l'agroalimentaire. Des données sur ces préférences ont été recueillie dans le cadre d'un sondage téléphonique auprès des habitants de l'Alberta, au début de 2000. On a ensuite élaboré et testé des modèles à logit conditionnel et à logits mixtes pour évaluer l'influence de divers paramètres socio‐économiques sur le choix d'une politique particulière par les répondants. Les mêmes modèles ont servi à estimer dans quelle mesure les répondants étaient prêt à payer pour une des deux options examinées, à savoir i) un système d'étiquetage des produits alimentaires les renseignant davantage sur l'usage de la biotechnologie en agriculture et ii) des inspections plus nombreuses pour les produits alimentaires… Durant l'entrevue, on a demandé aux consommateurs de choisir entre une de ces deux options et une réglementation plus sévère du recours à la biotechnologie en agriculture. Les résultats de l'analyse laissent croire que la plupart des consommateurs préfèrent et serait plus enclins à payer l'information obtenue grâce à une politique d'étiquetage; on privilégie un système d'étiquetage qui fournira plus de renseignements à une réglementation coercitive. De même, on préfère des inspections plus nombreuses à une réglementation plus sévère. Les préférences varient avec le sexe, les femmes acceptant plus que les hommes de payer davantage pour les deux options proposées (étiquetage et inspections) vis‐à‐vis de la biotechnologie.
abstract_zh:
本文报告了一项关于消费者对食品生物技术相关监管政策偏好的研究。我们于2000年初通过对阿尔伯塔省居民进行电话调查，收集了消费者对若干政策选项的选择数据。本文开发并检验了条件Logit模型和混合Logit模型。这些模型用于评估不同社会经济因素对受访者选择特定政策选项的影响，并用于估计受访者对本研究重点关注的两个政策选项的支付意愿，具体为：
一是提供更多农业生物技术食品信息的食品标签制度；
二是增加食品检验。
在电话访谈过程中，消费者被要求在上述政策选项之一与对农业生物技术实施更严格监管的选项之间做出选择。分析结果表明，受访消费者最倾向于并最愿意为食品标签政策所提供的信息支付费用；相较于更严格的监管，他们更偏好能够提供更多信息的标签政策。同样，相较于更严格的监管，增加食品检验的政策也更受青睐。在偏好方面存在性别差异：相对于农业生物技术，女性比男性更愿意为标签和检验这两种食品政策选项支付更多费用。
本文研究了消费者对规范食品生物技术的政策偏好。数据于2000年初通过对阿尔伯塔省居民的电话调查收集。研究开发了条件Logit模型和混合Logit模型，以评估不同社会经济因素对受访者选择特定政策选项的影响，并估计受访者对两项政策选项的支付意愿：一是提供更多农业生物技术食品信息的食品标签制度，二是增加食品检验。在电话访谈中，消费者被要求在上述政策选项与对农业生物技术实施更严格监管之间做出选择。分析结果表明，受访消费者最偏好食品标签政策所提供的信息，并最愿意为之付费；相比更严格的监管，他们更偏好提供更多信息的标签政策。同样，增加食品检验的政策相比更严格的监管也更受青睐。在偏好上存在性别差异：相对于农业生物技术，女性比男性更愿意为标签和检验这两种食品政策选项支付更多费用。

title: Trading off Health, Environmental and Genetic Modification Attributes in Foods
abstract: This study examines the trade-offs made by consumers between possible risks associated with genetically modified (GM) ingredients and potential health or environment benefits in food. A latent class model is used to analyse consumers’ preferences for GM food. There is considerable diversity amongst consumers in risk attitudes to GM food. The analysis reveals that trade-offs between risks and related concerns associated with GM food and benefits that may be associated with introduced health and environmental attributes of food depend upon individual’s characteristics. The findings have implications for public policies that seek to minimise the effects of perceived risk in food markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了消费者在转基因（GM）成分可能带来的风险与食品中潜在的健康或环境益处之间所作的权衡。本文使用潜在类别模型分析消费者对转基因食品的偏好。消费者对转基因食品的风险态度存在相当大的多样性。分析表明，消费者在转基因食品相关风险及其关切，与食品中引入的健康和环境属性所带来的益处之间的权衡，取决于个体特征。研究结果对旨在降低食品市场中感知风险影响的公共政策具有启示意义。
